tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// phag mo zhal gnyis ma mchod pa'i cho ga ras chung lugs bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// na maḥshrī badz+ra wā rā h+yai/ rnam pa thams cad kun nas legs spro ba'i// stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid bcom ldan ma// mchog gi bde ster bden gnyis zhal mnga' ba// bskal pa'i me dpung 'dra bar phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje btsun mo'i zhabs sen nyi 'od des// rgyal dbang thugs kyi gangs ri bzhu ba las// lam bzang gdams pa'i chu rgyun babs pa gang*// mchog 'dod rnams la kun dga'i skyes su gyur// byang chub tu sems bskyed cing dbang bskur ba yang dag pa thob pa/ mchog gi go 'phang la rings pa rings par chas pa'i sngags pas/ 'di nyid kyi byin gyis brlab pa nos nas dur khrod la sogs pa yid dang rjes su mthun pa'i dben gnas su/ stegs bu gtsang ma la rdul tshon gyi chos 'byung dang dbus su baṃ bris pa'i khar mañdzi'i stegs la dum bu gcig pa la sogs pa dag pa'i thod par/ dbus su baṃ yig bkod bdud rtsi ril bu sbyar ba'i chang bzang pos bkang*/ de'i khar me long dri ma med pa la gur kum la sogs sbyar bar bya/ chu bzang po dang ldan pa la/ sin+dhu ra yi phye mas btsag /gser gyi smyug gu'i sbyor ba yis// blo dang ldan pas e dbyibs bri/nyis rtsegs/ baṃ/dbus su sngags kyi rgyal po oṃ gsum ma ni// rim pa de bzhin bri bar bya// g.yung drung g.yon bskor 'khyil ba'i phyag rgya ni// dge ba'i 'khor lo'i logs la bkod// ces gsungs pa bzhin bcas/ mchod pa'i yo byad ji snyed pa dang gtor ma/ tsa ru'i bza' ba rdo rje dril bu cang te'u 1$00002201$0000280sogs dam tshig gi rdzas tshogs par byas te/ stan la rnal 'byor gyi rol pas rab tu bsngags pa'i gnas nub phyogs su bltas te 'dug par bya'o// dam tshig lnga dang ldan pa'i btung ba bzang po mchod sbyin gyi snod du bzhag pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis yang dag par sngags pa'i chu des/ lag pa g.yon nas brtsams te yan lag dang nying lag thams cad khrus bya zhing rtsa sngags brjod par bya'o// de nyid kyis mchod pa'i rdzas rnams gsang gtor byas la/

oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ mchod rdzas rnams mi dmigs pa stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du a las byung ba'i thod pa'i snod phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ bh+rūm̐ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ hūm̐/ lāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ bāṃ/ zhu ba las byung ba'i sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dang bcas pa la pheṃ gyi sgras bskul ba'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi sbyor mtshams nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang ro gcig tu 'dres/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥkha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ sarba bita pū ra pū ra/ ā warta ya ā warta ya hoḥbadz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ pā d+yaṃ swāhā/ añtsa mā naṃ swāhā/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li te/ pra dz+nyā pā ra mi tā/ nā da swa bhā we/ badz+ra dharma hṛ da ya san+to ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ aḥkhaṃ swāhā/ bgegs gtor/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ad+ya nut+pan+na twāta/ ces lan gsum brjod nas mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid/ bgegs kyi rgyal po bi nā ya ka /bdud kyi rgyal po dga' rab dbang phyug la sogs pa sa 'og sa steng sa bla gsum na gnas pa'i gnod byed gdon bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad mchod sbyin 'dis tshim par gyis la rang rang so so'i gnas su dengs shig /oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ gṛh+na gṛh+na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ gṛh+na pa ya gṛh+na pa ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ā na ya hoḥbha ga wān badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces bskrad nas/ oṃ me dī ni badz+ri bhā wa badz+ra ban+dha hūm̐ baṃ hūm̐/

rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ oṃ badz+ra pra kā ra hūm̐ paṃ hūm̐/ rdo rje'i rwa ba/ oṃ badz+ra pañtsā ra hūm̐ yaṃ hūm̐/ rdo rje'i gur/ oṃ badz+ra bi tā na hūm̐ khaṃ hūm̐/ rdo rje'i bla bre/ oṃ badz+ra sha ra dzā la trāṃ saṃ trāṃ/ rdo rje mda'i dra ba/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lārka hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phyi rol du rdo rje me ri rab tu 'bar bas bskor bar gyur/ de nas lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb mdzub gung srin mthe'u chung rnams kyi dbus su rim pa ji lta bar/ oṃ baṃ haṃ yauṃ hriṃ moṃ hreṃ hriṃ hūm̐ hūm̐/ rtsa ba dang rtse mo rnams la phaṭ phaṭ/ ces bya ba'i sngags kyi yi ge bsam zhing brjod pas/ lag pa g.yon pa'i sor mo rnams sbyangs nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /bde sdug gi rgyu chags sdang nye ring dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /ces tshad med bzhi bsgoms nas/ dag pa gsum brjod par byas te/ oṃ swa bh+wa wa shud+dhāḥsarba dharmāḥswa bh+wa wa shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥbadz+ra shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ rang lus khams gsum po rnam par dag pa'i gzhal yas khang du gyur pa'i lte bar/ skad cig tsam gyis bde ba chen po'i chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa'i dbus su/ rab tu dmar ba'i chu skyes dang*/ srog bral gyi snying gar nyin mor byed pa'i lte ba la/ baṃ yig gi 'od kyis sprul pa'i bcom ldan 'das nyi ma bdun gyi 'od dang 'char ka'i kha dog can/ nam mkhar phyogs pa'i g.yas kyi phag zhal mthing ga ni chos nyid don dam pa'i bden pa dang*/ yid tsam khros pa'i rtsa ba'i zhal mchog tu mdzes shing rgyas pa ni chos can kun rdzob kyi bden pa rnam par dag pa ste/

phag zhal las gyen du phyogs pa'i spyan gsum ni dus gsum gzigs pa dang*/ khro zhal las thad dkar phyogs pa'i spyan gsum ni khams gsum la gzigs pa/ dbu skra cung zad bcings pa lhod par gyur pa las gsil bur grol ba ni gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i rnam pa tsam las 'ching bar mi nus pa dang*/ mgo skam po lnga cod pan du 'dzin pa ni zag pa med pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis mdzes pa/ rab tu 'bar ba'i gri gug sngo bsangs g.yas pa'i phyag gis gyen du phyogs par 'dzin pas rnam par rtog pa'i zug rngu ma lus par gcod cing*/ bdud kyi khrag gis yongs su gang ba'i ka pā la g.yon pa'i phyag gis 'dzin pas zag pa med pa'i bde ba chen por dus rtag tu rol ba/ gru mo'i ngos la brten pa'i kha ṭāṃ ga ni shes rab kyi thabs yongs su mi gtong ba'i ngang tshul can dang*/ rdo rje sngon po'i thag pas brgyus pa'i mgo bo'i phreng bas yongs su bskor ba ni sems 'byung gi rgyu ba rnam par dag pa nyid dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ rna cha dang*/ mgul rgyan dang*/ gdu bu dang*/ ska rags te phyag rgya lnga yis rnam par brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas rol pa'i gar gyis g.yon pa'i brla la gtad cing*/ g.yon brkyang bas srog bral gyi snying ga mnan pa/ glo bur gyi dri ma'i gos dang bral ba'i gcer mo gdod nas dag pa nam mkha'i gos can ma/ dga' ba'i cha shas yongs su gang ba na tshod bcu drug ma'i nyams can/ ye shes kyi me'i phung po'i dbus su/ rab tu brjid cing mdzes par bzhugs pa'i lte ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus na/ oṃ baṃ phag mo dmar mo/ snying gar haṃ yauṃ gshin rje ma sngon mo/ mgrin par hriṃ moṃ rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ dpral bar hreṃ hriṃ sreg byed ma ser mo/ spyi bor hūm̐ hūm̐ skrag byed ma ljang khu/ yan lag dang nying lag thams cad la phaṭ phaṭ tsaṇ+ḍi ka dud kha/ gzhan yang spyi bor sku rdo rje'i ngo bo oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par gsung rdo rje'i ngo bo āḥdamar po/

snying gar thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo hūm̐ sngon po thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros lus la rdo rje'i go gyon/ lte bar baṃ/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i gzugs su steng gi nam mkha' la dbang gi lha dang bcas pa/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas pheṃ/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swāhā/ de bzhin du/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+das mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdagug gzhug cing mnyes par bya'o// nam mkha' gang ba'i lha tshogs rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ lha rnams kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i rin po che'i bum pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kun gyis khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin dag pa'i sku khrus gsol// oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur bas lus gang*/ dri ma dag /chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad rigs kyi con pan du gyur/ chos kun he ru ka yi dngos// bde chen dbyings las g.yo med kyang*// brtan dang g.yo ba'i rnam par snang*// gar mkhan tshul du rol bar bya// oṃ shrī badz+ra wā rā hī puṣ+pe pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes shap+ta'i bar du sbyar bas mchod/ phag gdong zhal ni mi g.yo'i spyan gyis steng gi nam mkha' dag la mkha' spyod phyag rgya ni// dga' ba 'khyil ba'i 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba la ni mngon par phyogs pas gzigs mdzad de// mdun du rnal 'byor can gyi spyod yul du mdzad rnam par 'phro ba'i sku mnga' dpal ldan ma// khams gsum kun gyi yid du 'ong zhing don kun phun tshogs sgrub byed de la phyag 'tshal lo// nang mchog gong ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā his myang ba ni nang gi rnal 'byor ro// da ni phyi rol mchod pa'i cho ga bshad par bya ste/

rdul tshon dang*/ sin+dhu ra/ thod pa'i bdud rtsi dang bcas pa bdud rtsis bsangs/ dag pa gsum gyi sngags brjod de/ dkyil 'khor rten dang bcas pa stong par gyur pa'i ngang las/ bde ba chen po chos gyi 'byung gnas zhes pa nas/ lte bar baṃ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bcings pa mig g.yon pa'i thad kyi dpral bar bskor zhing*/ oṃ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ gu ru shrī badz+ra yo gi nī/ ā kaḍ+ḍha ya/ ā kaḍ+ḍha ya/ pra be sha ya/ pra be sha ya/ ban+dha ya/ ban+dha ya/ to ṣa ya/ to ṣa ya/ sarba badz+ra ḍā ki? nī hṛ da ya/ a ba to ṣa ya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ.oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sarba wī ra yo gi nī swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i gzugs kyis sa gzhi dang bar snang thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swāhā 1$0000220nas/1$0000280 shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig gi 'khor lo dang ro gcig tu gyur/ slar yang baṃ yig gi 'od kyis bskul ba'i gdan gsum tshang ba dbang gi lha tshogs nam mkha' gang bas mdun bskyed kyi lha la dbang bskur du gsol/ lha rnams kyis nas cod pan du gyur ces pa'i bar snga ma bzhin du sbyar ro// de nas phyi mchod ni/ oṃ shrī badz+ra wā rā hī pra wa ra sat+ka rā ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du/ pād+yaṃ/ añtsa mā naṃ/ mchod yon zhabs bsil zhal bsil rnams phul nas shin tu snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis/ rab mdzes lta bas mi ngoms lang tsho can// dga' ba'i nyams bzhis sgeg cing 'gying ba'i gzugs// pi waṃ gling bu rnga zlum rdza rnga mas// rab 'byams nam mkha' bkang bas mchod par bgyi// oṃ āḥbadz+ra wī ne hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ waṃ se/ mṛ taṃ ke mu rañdze/ mchog dga'i nyams bzhis sgeg cing 'gying ba'i gzugs// bzhad dang dregs ldan glu dbyangs gar mkhan mas// hā s+ye/ lā s+ye/ gī tī/ nṛ t+ye/ khyad dga'i nyams bzhis sgeg cing 'gying ba'i gzugs// me tog bdug pa snang gsal dri chab mas// puṣ+pe/

dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ lhan skyes dga' bzhis sgeg cing 'gying ba'i gzugs// gzugs bcud reg bya chos dbyings rdo rje mas// rū pa/ rā sa/ spar+she/ dharma dhā tu/ g.yon pa'i srin lag gis nang mchod 'thor zhing*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo/ sku bzhi ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bka' rgyud bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rtsa sngags kyi gsham du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ btags pas rdo rje btsun mo la 'bul/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ma gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi= dam can chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi= de nas lag pa g.yon pa'i lag mthil du/ oṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor oṃ gyis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros gzung ba'i rtog pa bcom/ g.yas pa'i mthil du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor a yis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros 'dzin pa'i rtog pa bcom/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bong gi dbus su oṃ baṃ phag mo dmar mo/ mdzub mo'i ngos la haṃ yauṃ gshin rje ma sngon mo/ gung mo la hriṃ moṃ rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ ming med la hreṃ hriṃ sreg byed ma ser mo/ mthe'u chung la hūm̐ hūm̐ skrag byed ma ljang khu/ sor tshigs la phaṭ phaṭ tsaṇ+ḍi kā dud kha/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong la oṃ haḥrdo rje sems dpa' dkar po/ mdzub mo la na ma hi rnam par snang mdzad ser po/ gung mo la swāhā hu rin chen 'byung gnas dmar po/ srin lag la bau ṣa ṭa he he ru ka nag po/ mthe'u chung la hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥ'od dpag med mthing kha/ sen mo'i ngos la phaṭ haṃ don grub ljang khu/ rang rang las 'od 'phros/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang ye shes pa ro mnyam du gyur/ rtsa sngags kyi mthar oṃ baṃ haṃ yauṃ hriṃ moṃ hreṃ hriṃ phaṭ phaṭ/ oṃ haḥnā ma hi/ swa ha hu/ bauṣa ṭa he/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥphaṭ haṃ/

puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta/ oṃ shrī badz+ra yo gi nī pañtsa a mṛ ta pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lha tshogs la mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo// 'gal rkyen bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ thal mo sbyar nas lag pa'i lha rnams snyoms par zhugs te/ zag med kyi bde bas dgyes bzhin du bdag la thim par bsam/ gsang mchod ni/ 'khyud stangs kyi phyag rgyas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ sems rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang la 'jog pa de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'o// de bzhin gzhon nu ma yang mchod/ ces pas grong pa'i chos kyi ma gos pa lhar bskyed pa nas mchod pa'i rim pa 'di nyid kyis so// bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo 'phags ma ni// 'jig rten gsum sogs phyogs gzhan rgol bas mi thub cing*// 'byung po'i 'jigs pa ma lus rdo rje chen mos 'joms// rdo rje gdan bzhugs tshangs sogs dbang byed las ni rnam rgyal zhing*// rdo rje phag mo khro mo'i gzugs can drag snyems ma// rmongs byed rengs byed smyos byed las ni rnam rgyal zhing*// bdud kyi 'jigs pa phaṃ zhing skem par mdzad pa mo// rnal 'byor chen po 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ma la 'dud// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ni// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los bsgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma/ de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyas par 'dod na me tri zhabs kyi bstod chen kyang 'don par bya'o// de ni phyi rol mchod pa'i cho ga'o// da ni bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor bya ba ni/ rgya gzhung nas/

de yi pad+ma'i nang du ni// don kun sgrub byed 'khor lo me long la bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor ji lta ba bsgom// gru gsum gyis brgyan mtshan ma ni// kha dog dmar po 'od zer can// sngags kyi yi ge yongs rdzogs nas// rdza mkhan 'khor lo g.yon du 'khor ba bzhin du'o// srin po'i zhal ni cung zad bsdam// rab tu 'bar ba'i rnam par bsgom// phag gdong gyen du nye bar blta/ phag gdong gi spyan gyi thad kar*/g.yung drung 'khyil ba myur du 'khor// phyag rgya gnyis kyi rnal 'byor gyis// khams gsum po yang bsgrub par bya// zhes gsungs pa bzhin nam/ ma 'grub na/ rang nyid kyi lte ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su dga' ba 'khyil ba g.yon skor du 'khor bar dmigs nas/ rtsa ba'i sngags/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki? nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes rtse gcig tu bzlas so// de nas/ sdig pa thams cad bdag gis so sor bshags// dge ba kun la rjes su yi rang ngo*// chos kyi 'khor lo rin chen bskor bar bskul// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs// dge ba ma lus byang chub chen por bsngo// rnal 'byor bla med lam la brten par bgyi// 'gro ba'i don phyir sangs rgyas 'phrin las kun// ma lus rdzogs par bdag gis byed par shog /tsā ru'i bza' ba gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs/ nang mchod ltar phud phul/ yang na tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i rnam gzhag gzhan du bshad pa ltar bsgrub bo// de nas gtor ma gong ltar byin gyis brlab/ lte ba'i baṃ las 'od 'phros/ pheṃ pheṃ zhes sogs kyis sngags dang 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas gtor mgron spyan drangs la/ oṃ badz+ra ā ra li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki? nī sa ma ya s+t+wa dṛ ṣ+ya hoḥ zhes pa lngas 'das pa la phul/ oṃ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa rāk+ṣas/ bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tson+mā dā pasmā ra/

badz+ra ḍā ki? ḍā ki? n+yā da ya i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+nan+tu/ sa ma yaṃ rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarba sid+dhim+me pra ya ts+tshan+tu/ ya thai waṃ/ ya the ṣ+ṭaṃ/ bhuñdza tha/ khā da tha/ pi wa tha/ dzi gh+ra tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba ka ra ta ya/ sat+su khaṃ bi bṛ d+dha yes hā yi ka bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ lan gsum gyis 'jig rten pa rnams la 'bul bar bya'o// srid dang zhi ba mnyam pas chags pa bcom zhing yang dag lta ba bcom// khyod ni dngos po thams cad mkha' dang mnyam pa'i bdag nyid gzigs par ldan// mgon po thugs rje'i chu yi brjid kyis brlan par gyur pa'i thugs kyi chus// bdag la mdzod cig lha mo rnams kyis shin tu rjes brtser mdzad du gsol// oṃ yo ga shud+dhāḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes pad+ma'i lag bskor gyis mnyes par bya'o// dam can rgya mtsho khyed rnams kyis// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag stsol// dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi stong grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing phyug 'phel ba// bde legs thams cad 'grub pa dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /de bzhin pha rol tshogs 'joms shing*// dgra rnams thams cad pham par mdzod// mchod sbyin 'di yi mthu stobs kyis// bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub par shog /sems can thams cad sdig med cing*// sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sangs rgyas nyid dang phrad gyur pa'i// lam de nyid la zhugs nas kyang*// ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral ba dang*// ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang*// rnal 'byor gtsug lag dam tshig la// da lta nyid du gnas par shog

/oṃ badz+ra wā rā hī sa ma ya zhes dam tshig bskul/ byin brlab bya na 'dir bgyi/ tshogs la rol/ lhag ma btang nas/ badz+ra muḥ mdun bskyed dang gtor mgron ye shes pa rang la bstim/ sarba gats+tsha/ 'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje phag mo 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'khod par shog /rigs su skye dang dam tshig can// smyo med he ru ka dpal ston// bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pa rdo rje dril bu 'khrol// zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang*// btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas can// skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /nyes ltung dri mas ma gos shing*// rlabs chen spyod pa rdzogs pa dang*// rnal 'byor ma dang mnyam pa yi// go 'phang tshe 'dir thob par shog /bkra shis kyang ci rigs pa brjod par bya'o// rdul tshon a kā ro'i sngags kyis phyis/ sin+dhu ra phyis pa'i lhag ma smin mtshams su byug cing bsrung ngo*// rdo rje btsun mo'i zhabs kyi chu skyes la// lan brgyar reg pa grub pa'i mchog rnams kyis// gzhung du bsdebs la byis pa'i tshogs rnams kyang*// bde blag 'jug phyir bdag gis 'di byas so// 'dir 'bad dge ba'i 'od zer mu med pas// sgrib gnyis 'thug po'i mun nag kun gsal te// sgyu 'phrul rigs brgya'i skyed mdzad rnal 'byor ma'i// bzhin ras ji bzhin kun tu lta byed shog /sha wa ra dbang phyug dang*/ dpal mai tri pa yab sras kyi ring lugs ji lta ba paṇa chen nags kyi rin chen gyi man ngag gis gsal bar bgyis pa mtshungs med rgyal ba'i dbang pos gzhung du bsdebs pa la/ rgya gzhung gi dngos bstan dang bsgrigs pa'i zur gsal ba bgyis pa nyung ngu 'di ni pad+ma dkar pos g.ya' bzang chos mdzad bsod nams snying po'i ched du sbyar ba'o/// /
